prerequisites.requirement: One pilot jurisdiction is selected and represented by an effective-dated, sourced, versioned pack reviewed by qualified counsel.
prerequisites.blocker: No pilot state has been selected and no jurisdiction pack has been reviewed by qualified counsel. The engine reads effective-dated versioned packs, but the shipped values are synthetic development fixtures, not sourced law.
prerequisites.notes: Counsel review of Buyer-facing legal copy is part of this blocked scope; legal-and-product-copy verifies only the mechanical claim properties.

prerequisites.requirement: Automotive and processing provider terms document display, caching, attribution, derived-value, retention, deletion, training, regional-processing, coverage, and cost rights.
prerequisites.blocker: No automotive or processing provider terms have been executed. Every provider in the inventory is a deterministic local fake or an unselected candidate, so no display, caching, attribution, derived-value, retention, deletion, training, regional-processing, coverage or cost right has been contractually established. The integrated Anthropic and OpenAI model clients are disabled and each vendor's retention and training terms are recorded as unexecuted; the model rollout gate refuses to enable either until that vendor's terms are validated.

prerequisites.requirement: At least 100 permissioned representative Dealer documents are acquired, de-identified as appropriate, and split before evaluation into development and frozen held-out subsets.
prerequisites.blocker: No permissioned Dealer documents have been acquired. The extraction and review corpora are synthetic fixtures authored for contract evaluation, so neither the 100-document minimum nor a frozen held-out split exists.

prerequisites.requirement: A consumer-side automotive expert validates opening, target, and walk-away policy behavior against representative retrospective cases.
prerequisites.blocker: No consumer-side automotive expert has reviewed the boundary policy. Its arithmetic is unit-tested against synthetic market ranges, which does not establish that the resulting opening, target and walk-away values are sound negotiating advice.

prerequisites.requirement: Upload limits, materiality tolerances, confidence thresholds, market freshness/sample rules, and report-schema fixtures are frozen and versioned.
prerequisites.notes: Freezing pins the current engineering defaults under a version and fails the build on undeclared drift. It does not assert that the pinned values are the commercially correct pilot settings; changing one requires a new parameter version.

prerequisites.requirement: Recovery mechanism, infrastructure/provider choices, provider inventory, purposes, subprocessors, regions, retention, and deletion behavior are documented.
prerequisites.blocker: Cloudflare Workers and AWS EC2, RDS, S3, SES/SNS, SSM/KMS and ECR are selected with unapplied Terraform and a deployment runbook. The proposed AWS region is us-east-1; Cloudflare processes at its global edge. Company accounts, actual regions, processor terms, deployed startup/TLS/header/upload/preview checks, role isolation, physical deletion/backup expiry and restore verification remain pending. Infrastructure and privacy approval is still blocked.

prerequisites.requirement: Legal and product copy avoids unsupported law, advice, safety, fraud, guarantee, and savings claims and discloses relevant commercial relationships.
prerequisites.notes: The check scans shipped Buyer-facing copy and generated language for prohibited claim patterns and requires the commercial-relationship disclosure. It is a mechanical property, not counsel approval of the copy, which remains inside the blocked jurisdiction-pack scope.

prerequisites.requirement: Pilot success and safety thresholds are preregistered before pilot outcomes are reviewed; any unmet prerequisite explicitly blocks release.
prerequisites.blocker: No approved thresholds have been frozen. The freeze endpoint and this readiness gate enforce preregistration and block release, but the operator has not yet frozen approved success, safety and price-variant values, and the documented defaults are explicitly illustrative.

prerequisites.requirement: The readiness record includes reviewed Flyway migrations, Hibernate schema-validation results, entity ownership and fetch rules, database constraints, and evidence that no production schema depends on Hibernate auto-generation.
prerequisites.notes: The check applies every migration, runs Hibernate in validate mode against the migrated schema, asserts no configuration selects an auto-generating ddl-auto value, and writes the constraint and fetch inventory to backend/target/readiness/schema-evidence.json.

prerequisites.requirement: A real approved one-time payment provider replaces the development adapter before commercial pilot use.
prerequisites.blocker: DevelopmentNoChargeCheckout collects no payment and cannot start under production, prod, or pilot profiles. Ticket 32 owns the real payment provider and enabling purchases for the pilot.
